subject: At the opposite end of the church/clock tower?
author: SUFFUR
body:
Some days i make it, some i don't, and some i go all the way through, back over the jump and out through the chuch/clock tower, don't ask i think its be a fluke the 4 times i've done it clean. Don't hit the boost until half way across, then hit it, and just make it across, or drop underneath, with a little drift jump and get 230 to 240, and go under and miss that oncoming. Doing the hugging helps too.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Techno Noob
author: ichienkai
body:
Damn i would swap broadband providers in a second if i could be bothered with all the resetting of e-mails and stuff like that.... Tedious dude.  You missed it last night Bootleg, joined a room with some strangers and the host took me out twice one being a vertical - he said something like "How ya feelin about me right now man??" so i said shut up bollock face which kinda broke the ice!  Turns out he's a mate of Mr Streamings or Mr N however you wanna say it, and it turned into a good room with Streamings.  Host swaps it to Road Rage and i got the winning kill on Mr N on the Mountain! Hehehe felt bad afterward. 

By the way can anyone suggest the best way to tackle the jump on White Mountain Reverse? 

Boot you taught me to hug the left before the first small jump then switch to hug the right and jump with full boost but it doesnt work all the time for me - i can make it at 209mph with one tap on the brake before the land but no other way as consistent.  Its the place i got my biggest boost speed so far on that landing 310 but that was with your method Bootleg. If you get on tonight dude thats where i'll be messing around with the jump....
